commit.message: merge: Moving cpu features to filemap.cpp from aotCodeCache.cpp
feat: Add cpu features log on the validation code
feat: Adding missing properties to compare

Fixes JDK-8392453
JVM should be able to display AOT cache configurations

Add two new arguments to the printing methods of aot cache header:
 - output_for_diff: To print comparables properties between the JVM and
   the cache
 - actual_jvm_config: Print the actual JVM config instead of the cache
   configuration

And print the "ready-to-diff" outputs of both the cache and the actual
jvm configuration on two different logs, to be able to output them on
two different files to be able to quickly diff:
 - aot+verify+codecache for the cache configuration
 - aot+verify+os for the JVM configuration
